extra_quotes: Density functional theory calculations are first employed to optimize the crystal structures, while CAS+DDCI correlated wave-function calculations were used for the determination of the magnetic exchanges.
The geometric structure of RNiO2 was obtained through DFT-based structural optimization using the CRYSTAL23 code [27].

Since charge ordering can significantly affect magnetic exchange interactions, its absence in the computed structure may be responsible for the discrepancies between the calculated and experimental exchange couplings.
